entries.source: StAN, Fürstentum Ansbach, Geheimes Archiv: Oberamt Creglingen, Urkunden 351
entries.german: Lehenrevers: Asmus und sein Sohn Jeronimus von Rosenberg gegen die Markgrafen Friedrich und Sigmund von Brandenburg um etliche Wiesen zu Waldmannshofen. - Siegler: Asmus, Amtmann zu Uffenheim und Hieronymus, beide von Rosenberg, Ritter.
entries.english: Feudal acknowledgment: Asmus and his son Jeronimus von Rosenberg to Margraves Friedrich and Sigmund of Brandenburg regarding several meadows at Waldmannshofen. - Sealer: Asmus, Amtmann of Uffenheim, and Hieronymus, both von Rosenberg, Knights.

facts.content: with his son Hieronymus acknowledged meadows at Waldmannshofen as fiefs from Margraves Friedrich and Sigmund of Brandenburg.
with his father Asmus acknowledged meadows at Waldmannshofen as fiefs from Margraves Friedrich and Sigmund of Brandenburg.
